title: Thelma (2017). How do you read Themla's arc?

commenti.body:
I think that there's an extremely dark lens on the final scene of the movie - and in turn, Thelmas arc. 

The final shot is Thelma sitting on the college campus with Anja approaching. Thelma envisions Anja coming up to her and iirc touches her shoulder and gives her a kiss. Seconds later, this happens exactly the way that Thelma envisioned it - stating, to me, pretty obviously that Thelma is fully controlling Anja with her mind control powers. Perhaps its not malevolent and simply a girl living out wish fulfilment. The same way someone fantasises about living out their life with their crush - except that when Thelma fantasises about something - it actually happens because she's an all powerful being. 

It's not so much that Thelma is an evil entity who intends on puppet mastering everyone around her - but she's clearly just letting it happen. Which makes her objectively grey.
